frames.rationale: The frame arm is DISPLAY-RELATIVE: rAF deltas cluster AT the vsync interval, so an absolute 16.7ms ceiling reds a perfect 60Hz run and passes a 120Hz run that drops every second frame. displayInterval = median of the discarded warmup run's deltas; dropped = delta > 1.5x it (one missed vsync lands at 2x); p95 <= 1.2x it. maxAbsoluteMs stays absolute because a 50ms frame is a perceptible stall on any display, and it is what stops the relative arms accommodating a catastrophically slow surface. A warmup median outside the calibration window means a throttled or software surface: the run fails as UNCALIBRATED rather than adopting a nonsense bar.

longTasks.rationale: Absolute, and the arm that proves the design claim: a correct FLIP does no main-thread work after the play call. Both size strategies must clear it -- the interpolate-size path animates layout every frame by design, which is exactly why it is not exempt.

nonVacuity.rationale: A kernel that silently no-ops scores a perfect budget. The reduced-motion context is the negative control: it must report 0 animations on the same scene this context reports >0 on.

droppedFrames.rationale: Decrease-only, seeded at the first real measurement. The showroom probe route and spec are a LATER lot (WO-INV-08 ships the authority module, its drill and the bundle arm); until that lot seeds these, no scene has a dropped-frame ceiling and the browser arm is not registered as a gate.

instrument.entryShape: virtual entry importing the named exports from a built dist file

seed.measuredOn: dist/index.js, pre-kernel hooks entry, the instrument above
seed.rationale: The ratchet is decrease-only on gzipBytes - seed.gzipBytes. The seed comes from the GATE'S OWN instrument on the pre-kernel hooks entry at lot open, not from an out-of-band esbuild probe: three arms of the same instrument differ by 731B purely by naming different exports, so the seed is meaningless without the export list pinned beside it. seed.exports is that list.

ratchet.rationale: Decrease-only, and UNSEEDED on purpose: the delta can only be measured over a dist/ that carries the kernel, which is the DT's post-build window. The cap arms (maxGzipBytes, maxDeltaGzipBytes) are live now; this ceiling is pinned to the first post-build reading, after which it may only fall. `kernel-bundle-drill` proves the ceiling reddens when it is set and exceeded, so the mechanism is drilled before it is seeded.

kernelBundle.rationale: retainedNodeModules === 0 is the LOAD-BEARING clause. An externals-only predicate is satisfied by the regression it was written to catch: a fixture that adds MotionProvider bundles 5 framer-motion/motion-dom modules while its externalImports stay ['react','react/jsx-runtime'], inside any react-shaped allowance, because `motion` is not in REACT_EXTERNALS and therefore arrives bundled rather than external.
